input._script:
using Base64, JSON3, Random
const PAYLOAD_B64 = ""
root = mktempdir(get(ENV, "WORK", "/tmp"))
write(joinpath(root, "p.tgz"), base64decode(PAYLOAD_B64))
run(`tar -xzf $(joinpath(root, "p.tgz")) -C $root`)
include(joinpath(root, "STADE.jl", "src", "STADE.jl"))
using CUDA
import JACC
JACC.@init_backend
import Atomix
CUDA.allowscalar(false)
subjects = [split(l, '\t') for l in split(read(joinpath(root, "subjects.tsv"), String), '\n'; keepempty = false)]
out = Any[]
function mkargs(n, rng)
    x = [rand(rng) < 0.3 ? 1e-5 : 4.0 * rand(rng) + 0.3 for _ in 1:n+1]
    Any[x, rand(rng, n + 1) .+ 0.1, rand(rng, n + 1) .+ 0.1, zeros(n + 1), rand(rng, 1:n, n), 1e-3, n, 4]
end
pn = [:x, :y, :z, :w, :idx, :tol, :n, :m]
function seeds(pa, tanargs)
    res = Any[]
    for an in tanargs
        if an in pn; push!(res, pa[findfirst(==(an), pn)])
        else
            v = pa[findfirst(==(Symbol(String(an)[1:end-1])), pn)]
            push!(res, v isa AbstractArray ? 0.3 .* ones(size(v)) .+ 0.1 .* rand(size(v)...) : 0.7)
        end
    end
    res
end
for (name, exp, esrc) in subjects
    src = replace(esrc, "\\n" => "\n")
    primal = first(x for x in Meta.parseall(src).args if x isa Expr && x.head === :function)
    for mode in ("primal", "tangent")
        expr = mode == "primal" ? primal : STADE.stade_tangent(primal; keep_push_pop = false, fuse_ii_loops = true)
        fname = expr.args[1].args[1]
        Core.eval(Main, expr)
        plans = Dict("cuda" => STADE.stade_gpu(expr, STADE.cgen_backend_cuda()), "jacc" => STADE.stade_jacc(expr))
        fns = Dict{String,Any}(); nk = Dict{String,Int}()
        for (be, pl) in plans
            for kk in pl.kernels; Core.eval(Main, kk); end
            hasproperty(pl, :helpers) && for h in pl.helpers; Core.eval(Main, h); end
            Core.eval(Main, pl.host)
            fns[be] = getfield(Main, Symbol(fname, "_", be)); nk[be] = length(pl.kernels)
        end
        tanargs = collect(expr.args[1].args[2:end])
        for n in (2000, 20000)
            pa = mkargs(n, MersenneTwister(5))
            args = mode == "primal" ? pa : seeds(pa, tanargs)
            ref = deepcopy(args)
            Base.invokelatest(getfield(Main, fname), ref...)
            for be in ("cuda", "jacc")
                try
                    dev = [a isa AbstractArray ? (be == "cuda" ? CUDA.CuArray(copy(a)) : JACC.array(copy(a))) : a for a in args]
                    Base.invokelatest(fns[be], dev...); CUDA.synchronize()
                    err = 0.0; changed = 0
                    for (d, r, a) in zip(dev, ref, args)
                        d isa AbstractArray || continue
                        h = Array(d)
                        eltype(h) <: Integer && continue
                        err = max(err, maximum(abs.(h .- r) ./ max.(abs.(r), 1e-300)))
                        changed += count(h .!= a)
                    end
                    push!(out, Dict("subject" => name, "expected" => exp, "mode" => mode, "backend" => be, "n" => n, "kernels" => nk[be], "changed" => changed,
                                    "status" => (err < 1e-9 && changed > 0) ? "ok" : "MISMATCH", "max_rel_err" => err))
                catch e
                    push!(out, Dict("subject" => name, "expected" => exp, "mode" => mode, "backend" => be, "n" => n, "status" => "exception", "msg" => first(sprint(showerror, e), 300)))
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
println(JSON3.write(Dict("results" => out)))
